headline: THE FED MEETS JULY 29 — Gold Has Already Priced the Hold; Silver's Two Engines Are About to Split
snippet: With the July 28-29 FOMC meeting days away, GoldSilver.com's countdown analysis finds gold has already priced the 85%-consensus rate hold into its current ~$4,050 spot price — leaving silver as the more volatile trade, where two competing engines diverge sharply under hold vs. hike scenarios. Silver's 58% industrial demand share (solar, EVs, AI data-centre infrastructure) means rate clarity restores industrial buying that rate-anxiety suppresses; historically silver moves two to three times gold's percentage on FOMC hold decisions. Fed Chair Warsh's committee was split 9-to-8 at the June meeting, and a surprise hike would extend the pullback from January's $121.62 all-time high — making this the single most important near-term catalyst for junior silver equity investors in months.

headline: EQUINOX GOLD + ORLA MINING: 99.9% SHAREHOLDER APPROVAL — Both Votes Pass; Merger Closes July 31 (TSX: EQX / ORLA)
snippet: Equinox Gold shareholders approved the share-issuance resolution for its business combination with Orla Mining on July 22 (99.83% in favour), followed by Orla securityholders on July 23 (99.91% in favour). Each Orla share converts to 1.0 Equinox share plus US$0.0001 cash; post-close, Equinox holders will own ~67% and Orla holders ~33% of the combined company. A final order from the Supreme Court of British Columbia is expected at a July 28 hearing, with closing targeted July 31 — uniting Equinox's Greenstone (Ontario) and Los Filos (Mexico) operations with Orla's Camino Rojo (Mexico) mine into a diversified mid-tier gold producer with three producing assets and meaningful free-cash-flow generation at current gold prices.

headline: CALEDONIA MINING DRILLS 16m AT 6.04 g/t Au AT BLANKET ZIMBABWE — New Near-Surface Zone Found; Resource Update Due August (NYSE: CMCL)
snippet: Caledonia Mining Corporation plc (NYSE: CMCL) identified a previously unknown near-surface gold zone approximately 200 metres east of the nearest projected underground orebody at its 49%-owned Blanket Mine in Zimbabwe, using a 155-hole, 7,063-metre RC drill program and 13 trenches. Standout results include 16.00 metres at 6.04 g/t gold (sulphide) and 23.00 metres at 2.61 g/t (oxide from surface) — mineralisation with both heap-leach and conventional sulphide processing optionality at an already-producing, fully permitted mine. Caledonia will publish an updated Blanket resource statement in August 2026 and is evaluating a 10,000-tonne trial heap leach in H2; at current gold above $4,050/oz, near-surface oxide at a zero-permitting-risk site carries compelling project economics.

headline: DISCOVERY MINING +8% AFTER PAMOUR CONFIRMS LARGE-SCALE DEPOSIT — 17.36 g/t Au IN KEORA TREND; 3.7 Moz Open-Pit (TSX: DSV)
snippet: Discovery Mining Ltd. (TSX: DSV, OTCQX: DSVSF) reported results from 47 drill holes totalling 11,003 metres at the Pamour Mine near Timmins, Ontario — confirming and expanding a mineral resource across all three open-pit phases while opening two new high-grade target areas. Key intercepts include 17.36 g/t gold over 5.9 metres in the previously untested Keora Trend and 11.54 g/t over 5.1 metres at Pamour West. Pamour's current open-pit resource is 2.70 Moz indicated (64.8 Mt at 1.30 g/t) and 1.00 Moz inferred (23.3 Mt at 1.34 g/t). The stock rose 8.1% on the announcement, reflecting the market's interpretation that the Keora Trend opens a new high-grade underground dimension not captured in existing resource models.

headline: STRIKEPOINT GOLD: FINAL HERCULES RESULTS — 67.06m AT 0.53 g/t WITH 7.62m CORE AT 2.93 g/t; RESOURCE STUDY Q4 (TSXV: SKP)
snippet: StrikePoint Gold Inc. (TSXV: SKP) released the final assay batch from its 29-hole Spring 2026 drill program at the Hercules Gold Project in Nevada's Walker Lane — with standout hole H26005 returning 67.06 metres at 0.53 g/t Au and 11.69 g/t Ag including a 7.62-metre high-grade core at 2.93 g/t Au and 54.48 g/t Ag in the SW Cliffs area. The program expanded shallow, oxide gold mineralisation on the Cliffs Target, which now represents one of the larger continuous oxide gold intercepts in the Walker Lane junior space. A maiden resource estimate is targeted for Q4 2026; oxide deposits in Nevada's Walker Lane routinely attract acquisition interest and premium valuations given straightforward metallurgy and proximity to existing processing facilities.

headline: SAGA METALS: 53% Fe2O3, 7.68% TiO2 IN LABRADOR — 67 Holes Done, Maiden MRE Advancing at Radar Critical Minerals (TSXV: SAGA)
snippet: SAGA Metals Corp. (TSXV: SAGA) released July 22 additional assay results from drill holes R-0050 through R-0054 at the Trapper Zone within its 100%-owned Radar Titanium-Vanadium-Iron Project near Cartwright, Labrador — returning 53.07% Fe2O3, 7.68% TiO2, and 0.384% V2O5 from a program now at 17,448 metres across 67 holes with above-95% core recovery. Hole R-0061 contains 244.4 metres of continuous semi-massive oxide — among the programme's largest single intercepts — as the team builds the systematic dataset required for a maiden Mineral Resource Estimate. Vanadium demand for grid-scale battery storage is growing alongside iron-titanium demand from pigments and aerospace, making the Radar project a multi-commodity critical minerals story at a time when Western governments are actively incentivising domestic supply chains.

headline: CARIBOO ROSE BEGINS DRILLING AT LIGHTNING STRIKE BC — Previous Hole: 44.4m AT 0.77 g/t Au; At Least 5 New Holes Planned (TSXV: CRB)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Cariboo Rose Resources
snippet: Cariboo Rose Resources Ltd. (TSXV: CRB) commenced diamond drilling July 24 at its 100%-owned 4,193-hectare Lightning Strike Gold-Silver Project located 60 kilometres northeast of 100 Mile House, British Columbia — targeting at least five new holes on orogenic sediment-hosted gold-silver mineralisation in geological terrain analogous to Spanish Mountain (110 km north) and Frasergold (40 km north). The 2025 program returned 44.4 metres at 0.77 g/t Au and 37.1 g/t Ag (including 11.9 m at 1.58 g/t Au and 109.7 g/t Ag) from hole LSD25-01, demonstrating system continuity. The British Columbia Interior is seeing renewed junior explorer interest as infrastructure costs drop and processing options multiply; Lightning Strike sits in a camp with multiple multi-million-ounce precedents.

headline: SILVER47 CONFIRMS 2.74 Moz AgEq FROM SURFACE AT HUGHES NEVADA — Patented Claims, Highway-Adjacent, Reprocessing Study Underway (TSXV: AGA)
snippet: Silver47 Exploration Corp. (TSXV: AGA) confirmed an inferred mineral resource of 2.74 million ounces silver equivalent (1.80 Moz Ag + 11 koz Au at 68 g/t AgEq) at the surface from 21 auger holes across the historic Belmont mine tailings at the Hughes Project in Tonopah, Nevada. All 21 holes returned continuous mineralisation from surface to the base of the tailings at an average thickness of 3.3 metres — a geometry ideally suited to shallow heap leaching. Located on ~84 acres of patented private land immediately beside US Highway 6, the project removes most of the permitting and access friction typical of Western U.S. exploration. Active metallurgical testwork (agitated cyanide leach at current grind + two finer sizes, CIL tests) will determine process efficiency and recovery rates before any extraction decision.

headline: GOLDGROUP MINING ACCELERATES AFTER GOLD RESOURCE MERGER — Sprott-Backed; Multi-Asset Drill Programs Active Across Mexican Ops
snippet: Goldgroup Mining Inc. announced July 23 the acceleration of its multi-asset growth strategy following completion of its transformational merger with Gold Resource Corporation — creating an Eric Sprott-backed intermediate Mexican gold and silver producer with active drill programs and mine development plans running in parallel across multiple assets. The combined entity is advancing its El Aguila complex alongside other Mexican silver-gold properties, with the July 2 deal close enabling the deployment of combined capital and technical teams. Sprott's involvement provides both financing credibility and retail investor visibility in a market where mid-tier silver-gold producers with growing production profiles are attracting renewed institutional interest.

headline: NdPr ALLOY SURGES 21% TO $133/kg IN JULY — Second Straight Rare Earth Deficit; 9,000-Tonne Gap Set to DOUBLE by 2028
snippet: Neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) alloy surged 21.4% to $133.02/kg in July 2026 — part of a broader rally in NdPr oxide, neodymium metal, and praseodymium metal to new 2026 highs — as EV and wind turbine demand growth continues to outpace new mine production. The global NdPr market faces a second consecutive annual supply deficit of approximately 9,000 tonnes (~10% of total demand), projected to widen to 21,000 tonnes by 2028 according to BMI and Fitch Solutions. U.S. federal funding for a domestic 'mine-to-magnet' supply chain and enhanced tax credits for domestic production are supporting junior developers, making rare earth explorers with NdPr-dominant profiles among the most strategically relevant small-cap investments in the critical minerals space.

headline: COPPER'S WILD RIDE — What This Week's Price Volatility Signals for Silver, Lithium and Base Metals Broadly
snippet: The National's July 22 analysis of copper's 2026 price volatility — COMEX approaching a new all-time record while SHFE inventories have crashed 82% since early May — examines what extreme commodity price gyrations signal about the broader base and energy metals complex. As copper's spot-futures premium widens dramatically and the ICSG formally reversed its 2026 forecast from a 209,000-tonne surplus to a 150,000-tonne deficit, analysts are watching silver, lithium, and nickel for similar supply-chain disconnects driven by tariff-front-running, electrification demand, and constrained mine output. The piece contextualises copper as the leading indicator for junior mining valuations across the energy transition metals — making its directional moves unusually important for investors across the sector.
